newsitem.title: GERMANY: SWIMMING-HAN XUE BREAKS SECOND WORLD RECORD IN A WEEK.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-HAN XUE BREAKS SECOND WORLD RECORD IN A WEEK.

text.p: China's Han Xue broke her own world record for the short-course women's 50 metres breaststroke for the second time in a week at the Gelsenkirchen World Cup meeting on Sunday.
Han, 15, powered through the German pool to clock 30.77 seconds on the second day of the meeting. She had set the previous best of 30.88 in the previous World Cup meeting in Glasgow last Wednesday.
The performance was the third world record of the two-day meeting.
